### The Question

Why does pruning remove none of this repository’s worktrees?

### The Code in Question

Worktrunk v0.81.0’s [`step/prune.rs`](https://github.com/max-sixty/worktrunk/blob/v0.81.0/src/commands/step/prune.rs#L399-L409) filters candidates; [`integration.rs`](https://github.com/max-sixty/worktrunk/blob/v0.81.0/src/git/repository/integration.rs#L107-L137) checks whether their changes reached the target.

### What We Found

- **[Direct]** All six worktrees currently recognized as integrated are dirty. Five contain only an untracked `.audit/` directory: `remove-mp-recent-declarations`, `funder-period-totals`, `member-money-sources`, `mp-calendar-year-totals`, and `feat/mp-declared-table`. `homepage-charts-frontend` has 17 tracked changes. Evidence: local `wt list --format=json`.
- **[Direct]** Prune skips dirty worktrees, including untracked files. It filters these silently, which explains the misleading “No merged worktrees to remove” result. Sources: [official documentation](https://worktrunk.dev/step/#wt-step-prune), [filtering implementation](https://github.com/max-sixty/worktrunk/blob/v0.81.0/src/commands/step/prune.rs#L399-L409).
- **[Direct]** None of the other 28 linked worktrees is currently recognized as integrated. Removing the default age restriction changes nothing: `wt step prune --dry-run --min-age=0s` returns the same result. Evidence: local command output.

In this installed version, the command is `wt step prune`; literal `wt prune` reports an unknown subcommand.

### What We Can Reasonably Infer

- **[Inferred]** Stale refs may hide additional integrated branches: local `main` and `origin/main` are `5b05d19`, while live GitHub `main` is `a01264d`. Eligibility after fetching remains unverified.

### What We Don't Know

Whether fetching reveals more candidates. Worktrunk also documents [conservative integration detection](https://github.com/max-sixty/worktrunk/blob/v0.81.0/src/git/repository/integration.rs#L107-L137), so “not recognized” does not establish “never merged.”

Inspect the five `.audit/` directories and move anything worth retaining outside those worktrees, then run:

```sh
git fetch origin
wt step prune --dry-run
```

Preserve the tracked changes in `homepage-charts-frontend`. Nothing was modified during this investigation.

### Sources Consulted

- **Source control:** local worktree status, remote refs, official source and documentation.
- **Issue tracker:** #1818, #948, #3004; no confirmed current defect established.
- **Long-form documents:** skipped; connected Drive cannot determine local Git eligibility.
- **Team chat:** unavailable.
- **Infrastructure observability:** skipped; unrelated to local Git eligibility.
- **Error tracking:** skipped for the same reason.
- **Product analytics:** skipped for the same reason.

### Confidence Summary

High confidence: dirty worktrees explain why all six recognized integrated candidates are skipped. Additional eligibility after refreshing refs remains unknown.
